name: GAN 16 ui 3x3 Max (Magnetic, MagLev, Core Magnets, UV Coated) - Minions Edition, Bluetooth Smart Cube
description: The GAN 16 ui 3x3 Max (Magnetic, MagLev, Core Magnets, UV Coated) - Minions Edition, Bluetooth Smart Cube brings the mischief of Illumination's Minions to a fully-featured smart speed cube. It pairs a translucent Minions-movie color scheme with GAN's smart-tracking tech, a MagLev core, and 72 speeding-level handfeel gears, so it reads as a collectible and solves like a competition-ready flagship.
features: Smart cube tech: Connects over Bluetooth to track your solves, capture moves, and sync your progress in the app.
Dedicated in-app benefits: Unlocks a movie-themed skin, a Minions startup animation, an avatar frame, and a movie-themed solve effect.
Complete themed kit: Ships as a limited gift set with everything you need to make it yours out of the box.
72 speeding-level handfeel gears: Dial in the exact turning speed and feel you want across a wide range of settings.
Personalized modeling: Set up the cube to your own solving style through the app.
Minions special tuning tool: A custom themed adjustment tool is included for setup by hand.
